Assuming that some kind of higher power does exist, in a perfect universe what would you want that to be?

For me I wouldn't want a presence that is good or evil. I would want it to have flaws and strengths but good intentions. It perhaps created the universe but for the most part left things to their own devices. There would be an afterlife where you are free to do as you please. You can stay in "heaven" where anything you desire can be a reality as long as you aren't impeding on the will of others. This heaven would be a spiritual plane of existence with one or multiple worlds to explore, live in, and interact with others. Souls could also observe the mortal realm but no interaction is possible. It would be possible to die for good but only if that is what you want.

I guess in the end I don't really care about god so much as I do mortality. I only want something to exist so there is a way beyond our control to circumvent death.
